title.label: Browser access is a game changer

content.label: I was originally put off bear as it’s limited to the Apple ecosystem; as I have to use a windows PC at times. They’ve recently released a beta of browser access to your notes. It’s awesome. Feels great and acts like a Mac app. I rarely write reviews, but I feel Bear have really earned it. They price their app fairly, have a beautiful product and are a small team. They certainly have my support going forward.

title.label: Best app for notes, minor improvements needed

content.label:
✅I tried so many apps from start of sixth form upto university as this is the only one that isn’t visually overwhelming
✅ Good default font and option to use Apple Pencil for handwritten notes
✅ So many quick simple shortcuts 
✅ Option to convert to word doc and pdf 
✅ Easy to organise by hashtags 
❌ No real page breaks like word so everything can be jumbled when you print it out as there might be one sentence on another page and you can’t do anything about it 
❌ Be careful while syncing across devices, especially if not iOS based and using Bear Web ! Sometimes it might not syncing leading to rewriting a whole note!
I don’t use it on the web anymore because I had to redo a whole lecture as it didn’t sync
💡I’d love to see real pagebreaks added and maybe a timer or podmoro too. Maybe call it a bearmoro? 

VERDICT 5 STARS, (4.7 if I had the option of decimals)🥰🐻
Dropped in capability. Getting very buggy in recent year.
I love Bear, and use it on iOS and macOS. Previously I was an Obsidian guy, but it never really felt solid enough. Bear does. Thank-you, Bear team!

The only reason I’ve been using Bear for 6 years is because it seemed to be the most powerful as well as efficient way to store information in an easily accessible way. However, I’ve recently noticed that the current UI has gotten rid of the ability to take and save photos directly in the app. So now, I have to take a photo. Then copy and paste it onto Bear. Terribly inconvenient and loses one of the deal-breaker features that kept me with Bear. Now, I’m actively looking for alternatives.

I had to write a review after seeing another review title ‘Underhanded’. I have nothing affiliation with Bear other than being than being a user since 2016, and I can say that what this user is claiming is untrue. The feature he mentions have not been paywalled  after previously being free. The review should be removed by Apple.

this app ALWAYS freezes whenever i try use the search function. i’m now trapped in a loop of trying to get out of the search function, force closing the app, the app opening on the search function, freezing, repeat. i can’t use it and it’s very frustrating
Does everything I need. Signed up to the subscription last year and never looked back. I use it for everything and recommend it to anyone looking for anything a step above the Apple Notes app.

title.label: Biggest of bear to ever bear.

content.label: Yeah

I love this. I never feel like I’m missing out on premium features. It’s my go to note taking app and has nice widgets. Love the hashtag based “file system” too, and the punctuation keyboard is very stylish and practical, with intuitive keyboard shortcuts.
Can be a useful app, but overshadowed by having repeatedly placed me in incredible stress four times in not saving my notes despite copies.

I like markdown, so I was looking for a good solution for my notes. I use this on my phone, iPad and desktop. What can I say? It is beautiful and backed by Apple iCloud security. I love it and should have download this sooner.

Only been using it a month so far but have been really enjoying how simple and clean it is. Not like other note apps which are bloated with unnecessary features. It’s all in Markdown format too which is a massive plus! Keep it up

title.label: No clue what this app is for

content.label:
I don’t get this app at all. I don’t understand what it’s used for since there’s no examples of how to use it or how it would look. What I thought it was, was an app to store categories and attach excel and work documents to which would have been great, but I just don’t get this….

Please share screen shots of examples.

I love working with this app. I tried out the free version, which is fine, but the subscription version is worth the upgrade in my book. Such a clean interface and a real pleasure to work on. Things like Word seem really clunky now. There’s no way back :-)
Tries to do too much. As a result i find it cluttered and hard to use.

title.label: Tried Them All, This is the One

content.label: Coming from all of the apps, including Obsidian, Apple Notes, OneNote, etc. This is just notes and tags with a clean simple interface. Easy export to markdown for your own peace of mind, but clean sync and a very affordable price.

title.label: Brilliant, replaced Goodnotes, Apple notes and drafts

content.label:
Super simple to use, but very powerful. Like Goodnotes I can hand write things and draw diagrams on my iPad, but now I can find everything because of the tags. Clean export to PDF is great for corporate documents. 

Scales better than Apple notes, and somehow easier to use. 

Recommended.

name.label: Let me tell u what I think!

content.label:
Ever since I got this app it has just got me changing the fonts and highlighting random notes and well in conclusion it is just fantastic and everyone should get this in my opinion and to be honest the bear pro  can be worth it but even if you just get the original it will still be a great experience. 

Bear also helps with planning for future events and provides many opportunities in a way which they can be separated into chunks and if needed a limit of words it will count your characters in total .

In the end, I love this app and loads of people should get it 💕
I love this app but after the newest update whenever I click on my notes it keeps crashing. Please get this fixed.

Before it got the major upgrade I moved to Obsidian - as anything JS based it runs poorly in my opinion and had all sort of other sync issues, search was not good etc. Now that most essential features are in Bearapp, happy to say it is gives me more or less all I need. Would appreciate however support for linking to a specific place in a PDF theough hookmark and more flexible resize for images e.g larger than actual size. Anyways it is perfectly useable and I like it

title.label: I tried and haven't seen anything better

content.label: This app is amazing. One of those that understood and implemented apple design guidelines to an extent that it feels native. Priced so low and yet features are so powerful. Please keep going. I'm supporting it all the way.

I love how simple and minimal the app is, it has increased my productivity a lot. My experience with other note taking app always used to follow the same pattern: I would spend hours and hours to optimize it, re-organize it, create workflows etc. Then I would drop them in just few weeks, to jump on another app.
Bear is different. I love how simple and straight forward Bear is: there’s a lot of functions that don’t distract you from your daily use, and I LOVE how many shortcuts I can use. It’s so handy to use the app without leaving your keyboard. My favorite shortcut is Cmd+Shift+8! I use it to add the date when I finish a task, before ticking the To-Do box (with cmd+. ;) ).
I really look forward to the web version of the app, because currently i can use it on all my device expect on Windows! It’s so annoying because on Windows there’s not really an alternative app that follows Bear’s approach and philosophy. That says enough about how unique Bear is. Thank you Bear team!

I have been using Bear for years and I love it.

I especially love the specific font for dyslexia, making it a breeze to read long notes

title.label: Apps like this are why I use Apple products

content.label:
I have to use Windows and Linux for work, there is no requirement for me to use MacOS, but it’s apps like this one and a few others that just don’t exist on other platforms. 

Bear is an example of a pretty much perfect note taking app. Try it for yourself.
If you want better organisation and formatting control than Apple Notes then look no further. Every update brings well considered, immaculately implemented new features.

title.label: Can’t change the colour of the font

content.label: Can’t change the colour of the font which is such a shame and makes no sense at all, can’t leave Evernote at all been using it for years now!!

Love this app for logging creative notes etc. one thing I’d love is a simple way to add images. Unless I’m missing something, and I have the Pro version; I find that copying a photo from another source eg photos and having to paste into a note, not that intuitive. Otherwise I love everything else and the tagging system is great.

title.label: Short term memory issues and Bear makes life easier

content.label:
Great App and use it as a single source of truth. 

I have short term memory issues and using tags and search make it so much easier to find information. 

I create structure with tags to link information together to make it easier to discover and follow.

title.label: Wonderful app for pure Apple users

content.label: I tried this app and loved it. It is undoubtedly great at what it does. For me, however, there is one problem: it doesn’t work on Windows. At home and on the move I use only Apple devices. The problem is at work I have to use a Windows machine and this does not have an option for that (I ended up using Obsidian for this reason). If a Windows version became available, I’d definitely sign up.

title.label: Amazing, but useless if you cannot change the folder

content.label: The app looks great, and beautiful. But unfortunately you cannot change the default folder of the files, locking you to their folder. I have a Git repo I would love to sync with, I have the folder mapped locally, but since I cannot change the folder on Bear, I cannot use it. Hope they can change that in the future, it was the only downside!
Loving this app so far

title.label: The best looking note taking app

content.label: Pure joy to use it.

I’ve really enjoyed using the app, I love the simple and minimalist layout and how easy it is to use but unfortunately one time all of a sudden I couldn’t access the app and even after refreshing / closing the app /  uninstalling and installing it again I couldn’t open it. I thought I’ve lost all of my notes. Thankfully, after an update that appeared couple months after the incident, I was able to access the app and see all of my notes again. That’s why I stopped using the app even though I really liked it at the beginning. Just be careful while using it, maybe copy the notes into other app or program so you always have a backup.
Images can be super glitchy and move in front of the text when I’m trying to type. It’s a real pain and is ruining the app for me.

Good app with features that Apple is finally catching up on but what sold me on premium was…

APP FACE ID / PASSWORD.

I know notes has as similar features but its only on selected notes and the title is still visible… its so easy for someone to take my phone when im drunk or something and see everything im writing about.

Im currently using this app as my project manger and 2nd brain for projects im working on. App is quite basic and intuitive but you can make it do serious work if you are creative enough with how you structure it.

I hated the hashtag system at first but now I prefer it over Apple note and folders.

Worth the money and affordable for my needs.

title.label: I WANT THE OLD VERSION BACK

content.label: Really don’t like this new version of design and it’s not concise and not as convenient before. I used to use bear everyday for writing but now I’m really disappointed and have to look for an alternative now.

My Bear no longer sync to my photos. After years of being a pro user I’m so lost without my old friend. I won’t be able to renew if this is not fixed.
I searched for ages to find my perfect journal. Now it looks like my search has to begin again.
😔

Add folders and it’ll be fine.

Nothing jogs a memory better than a quick flick through folders. A tag search feature is fine, but, have that as well as folders.

Been looking for a decent note taking app. Saw a review for this app on YouTube and decided to try it. 

It’s ok, bland, no decorative options from what I can see.

Do like the formatting.

One BIG FLAW for me is that there is no lifetime subscription. You want me to pay monthly or yearly to write stuff down? Not a chance in hell.

title.label: The most lightweight note taking app

content.label: Been using Bear for so many years now and appreciate the team for keeping the app lightweight and not bloating with features overtime.

This is a simple notes app with a lot of features. I have used it from its early days. It has been a long wait for Version 2 but it has been worth it. There is now a greater flexibility; accessing options as you write notes is more straightforward; and you can hide Markdown coding. The range of themes enables me to customise appearance for comfortable reading. There are more options for exporting notes than in the native IOS app. You can give notes strong security protection, which puts Bear above another attractive Notes app, Upnote: and for those of us with not-so-good eyesight, Bear offers the option of larger font sizes than Upnote.

There is a modestly-priced annual subscription for the Pro version. This is a lot less than eg the bloated Evernote, and worth it.

If you are writing a full-length book, an app like Ulysses may be preferable. For the rest of us, Bear is great. It is, though, limited to Apple devices, but the developers are working on a web version.

I love the updated version of the App and it's one of my tools to use every single day. I moved away from Bear for a period due to it’s limited capability in version 1 but every single one of those has been sorted in version 2.0.

title.label: Wish to edit quick date shortcut’s format

content.label:
User of many years. Favourite editor. Inspiring. Strongly recommend to allow formatting the date/time, or at least add one more format
YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM
Just looks cleaner and less distracting. 

Also consider to add button for adding date at much higher level of menu in iOS for rapid date/time adding. Will improve efficiency significantly for noting. I can use it for logging, jotting down quick thoughts. Would be brilliant.
Used to be a great app but their updates and anything new has disappeared

Bear has been my favorite note-taking application. I have been eagerly awaiting this update for over two years. The word was that you were working on it! 
However, all I can see now are numerous bugs, and unwanted changes to my notes structure. 
While I understand that there are a significant number of new features, however that doesn't justify releasing an app with major and obvious bugs. 
I'm only giving it two stars due to the memories of its good old days.

No longer compatible in terms of images from my Mac to my IOS devices. Such as shame, was my go to for all sorts of things. Really disappointed, you had a customer for life, now I have to find an alternative.

Bear have taken a fantastic product that was compatible across phones, Mac and iPad and made it useless. It is such a pity when a group of software engineers over complicate a simple neat product into a slow incompatible unreliable mess. After using Bear for many years and being extremely happy I am now looking for its replacement
I used to love this app but then it automatically updated on me today and when i try to click on my text to copy etc, these stupid little zoom bubbles come up on the screen that you can’t get rid of.

title.label: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it

content.label: Is there any way I can revert back to the old version? My app automatically updated itself, which I don’t have switched on in the first place. Not a fan of the new format, makes typing notes much more infuriating and annoying when it keeps switching focus all the time.
